<script lang="ts" generics="T">
	import { ArrowUpIcon, ArrowDownIcon, ChevronsUpDownIcon } from "@lucide/svelte";
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import type { ColumnHeaderProps } from "./index.js";
	const { table, column }: ColumnHeaderProps<T> = $props();
	// Columns sort by default when they have a value to sort by.
	const isSortable = $derived(column.sortable ?? !!column.accessor);
	const direction = $derived(table.sort?.id === column.id ? (table.sort.desc ? "desc" : "asc") : undefined);
</script>

<!-- A sortable heading is a ghost button with the direction arrow; other headings are plain text. -->
{#if isSortable}
	<Button variant="ghost" size="sm" class="dataTableSortButton" onclick={() => table.toggleSort(column.id)}>
		{column.header}
		{#if direction === "asc"}
			<ArrowUpIcon aria-hidden="true" />
		{:else if direction === "desc"}
			<ArrowDownIcon aria-hidden="true" />
		{:else}
			<ChevronsUpDownIcon aria-hidden="true" />
		{/if}
	</Button>
{:else}
	{column.header}
{/if}

<style>
	/* The button's padding lines its text up with the cells below */
	:global(.dataTableSortButton) {
		margin-inline: calc(var(--spacing-sm) * -1);
	}
</style>

{#if table.enableRowSelection} {table.selectedRowList.length} of {table.filteredRows.length} row(s) selected. {:else} {table.filteredRows.length} row(s). {/if}

table.setPageSize(Number(e.currentTarget.value))}> {#each pageSizes as pageSize (pageSize)} {pageSize} {/each}

Page {table.pageIndex + 1} of {table.pageCount}

<script lang="ts" generics="T">
	import { Settings2Icon } from "@lucide/svelte";
	import { Button } from "#lib/components/ui/button/index.js";
	import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuSeparator, DropdownMenuCheckboxItem } from "#lib/components/ui/dropdown-menu/index.js";
	import type { ViewOptionsProps } from "./index.js";
	const { table }: ViewOptionsProps<T> = $props();
	const hideableColumns = $derived(table.columns.filter((column) => column.hideable !== false));
</script>

<!-- Menu of checkboxes, one per column that can be hidden. -->
<DropdownMenu align="end" size="sm">
	<DropdownMenuTrigger>
		{#snippet trigger({ props })}
			<Button variant="outline" size="sm" {...props}><Settings2Icon />View</Button>
		{/snippet}
	</DropdownMenuTrigger>
	<DropdownMenuContent>
		<DropdownMenuLabel>Toggle columns</DropdownMenuLabel>
		<DropdownMenuSeparator />
		{#each hideableColumns as column (column.id)}
			<DropdownMenuCheckboxItem checked={!table.hiddenColumns[column.id]} onCheckedChange={(checked) => table.setColumnVisible(column.id, checked)}>
				{column.header}
			</DropdownMenuCheckboxItem>
		{/each}
	</DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>

description: A data table with sorting, filtering, pagination, column visibility, and row selection, built on the table.
